<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ComputerRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer brought in"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairCost" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CostDecision" name="Cost decision"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer brought in" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Defect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairCost" name="Repair cost calculation" sourceRef="SendTask_HandOutCost" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CostDecision" name="Cost decision" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="CatchEvent_CostDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Defect" name="Defective computer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DefectiveComputer" messageRef="Msg_DefectiveComputer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateCost" name="Calculate repair cost"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_HandOutCost" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Msg_RepairCost"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_CostDecision" name="Customer decision received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostDecision" messageRef="Msg_CostDecision"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CostAcceptable" name="Costs acceptable?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Unrepaired" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Start repair"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterHardware" name="Test system functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterSoftware" name="Test system functionality"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Repair activities done"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorMerge" name="Merge after test"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorCheck" name="Error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherRepair" name="Execute another repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterFurtherRepair" name="Test system functionality"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Finished" name="Repair finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Defect" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_CalculateCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CalculateCost" targetRef="SendTask_HandOutCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="SendTask_HandOutCost" targetRef="CatchEvent_CostDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="CatchEvent_CostDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CostAcceptable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostAccepted" name="Costs acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_CostAcceptable" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostRejected" name="Costs not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_CostAcceptable" targetRef="EndEvent_Unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestAfterHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestAfterSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ErrorYes" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="Task_FurtherRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ErrorNo" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_Finished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_FurtherRepair" targetRef="Task_TestAfterFurtherRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterFurtherRepair" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
